title: CI on main is red since 2026-08-22 because of the `npm audit --audit-level=high` step, not lint or tests
evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:33-36 (Audit step) vs gh run 33221729619 log-failed: 'nanoid <3.3.18 ... 1 high severity vulnerability ... exit code 1'
detail: All three failing main runs (32549982078 08-22, 33034689162 08-27, 33221729619 08-28) die at the 'Audit (high severity)' step; tests and build pass first (steps run in order, lint never reached). Latest run reports 1 high (nanoid GHSA-2v37-7h3g-55p8); locally there are now 2 highs (nanoid 3.3.17 via @tailwindcss/postcss->postcss@8.5.23, and browserslist 4.28.6 via eslint-config-next->eslint-plugin-react-hooks->@babel/core, GHSA-c83g-rgw3-j3cx + GHSA-73wf-gq98-2v4g). Both are devDependency-only; neither reaches the static export. Registry check: postcss@8.5.23 declares nanoid ^3.3.16 and 3.3.18 is published; @babel/helper-compilation-targets declares browserslist ^4.24.0 and 4.28.8 is published, update-browserslist-db peer >=4.21.0. bucket_reason: CI gate is red on main; one-command lockfile fix

title: audit:live has two tests that cannot pass on production: they assert layers that PUBLIC_LAYER_IDS gating removed (tenure-cutblocks, fish-streams)
evidence: e2e/monitoring/live-health.spec.ts:170-201 ('tenure-cutblocks vector tiles render features at z11') and :225-266 ('D3: fish-streams WFS returns features') vs src/lib/layers/registry.ts:882-890 (PUBLIC_LAYER_IDS = forest-age, old-growth-250, cutblocks, parks, fire-history, tap-priority, satellite) and src/hooks/useLayerState.ts:58,102 (hash ids filtered against LAYER_REGISTRY_AVAILABLE)
detail: Neither 'tenure-cutblocks' nor 'fish-streams' is in PUBLIC_LAYER_IDS, so on opencanopy.ca the MapLibre layers 'layer-tenure-cutblocks-tiles-fill' and 'layer-fish-streams-line' never exist and '#layers=fish-streams' is dropped by hydration. queryRenderedFeatures with an unknown layer id returns [] (MapLibre fires an error event), so featureCount is 0, not -1, and the skip branch is not taken: both tests FAIL deterministically, each burning 3 retries x ~60s idle waits. The 2026-08-26 fix 71ddef2 only corrected the old-growth-250 test; these two predate the public-surface narrowing (git log shows them from 53ff3a8 / 1e8d331, before PUBLIC_LAYER_IDS). The header comment also says 'Checks: 1-8' but there are 9 tests. Fix: drop or rewrite the two tests against public layers — cutblocks fill at z11 (layer-cutblocks-tiles-fill, enabled via #layers=cutblocks) already covers the tile path, and the D3 cqlFilter proxy gate is still exercised by the request-level cutblocks test at :268-286; fish-streams has no public surface, so its WFS gate should move to a direct /api/wfs?layer=fish-streams request like the cutblocks one. This is the only live monitor the project has and it is currently red-by-construction, so its signal is zero.
bucket_reason: the live-QA guard fails by construction on every run; monitoring signal is zero until fixed

title: Screenshot 'layer isolation' suite never isolates a layer: it loops 12 pipeline source-layers on a default /map, 5 of which are non-public, and carries a stale MapLibre id for conservation-priority
evidence: e2e/screenshots/screenshot-regression.spec.ts:166-214 (loop over EXPECTED_SOURCE_LAYERS, no layer enable, screenshot regardless of featureCount -2) and scripts/lib/bc-sample-grid.ts:71-84 (SOURCE_TO_MAPLIBRE['conservation-priority'] = 'layer-conservation-priority-tiles-fill')
detail: The 12 'layer isolation' tests goto('/map'), fly to BC centre z7, and screenshot — but never toggle any layer on or others off, so every one of the 12 screenshots is the same default view, and the per-layer featureCount is informational only (a -2 'layer not found' is logged then the screenshot is still captured and compared). conservancies, ogma, wildlife-habitat-areas, ungulate-winter-range, community-watersheds, mining-claims, forestry-roads are gated out by PUBLIC_LAYER_IDS so their MapLibre ids never exist; and the one that does exist under a renamed registry id (tap-priority, sourceLayer 'conservation-priority') is looked up under the pre-585dd0b id 'layer-conservation-priority-tiles-fill' — the id is built from the REGISTRY id (DataLayer.tsx:284 `layer-${layer.id}-tiles-fill`), so it should be 'layer-tap-priority-tiles-fill'. SOURCE_TO_MAPLIBRE also assumes a 1:1 source-layer to registry-id map that no longer holds (old-growth-250, logging-risk and forest-age all read sourceLayer 'forest-age'). Net: the isolation suite is 12 copies of one screenshot with a hollow feature probe. The 36-viewport suite above it is sound in shape (real navigate + pixelmatch) but needs a MapTiler key + dev server, which is why it has never run in CI. Recommend: rewrite the isolation loop over LAYER_REGISTRY_AVAILABLE, navigate with `#layers=<id>` so exactly one layer is on, and derive the MapLibre id from the registry (id + style.type) instead of a hand-kept map. Bucket B because the loop rewrite changes what the suite guards and needs a real run to seed baselines.
bucket_reason: test-only; needs a real keyed run on Lee's machine to seed baselines, so route rather than apply blind

title: CONTRIBUTING's 'add a layer' recipe produces an invisible layer: it omits PUBLIC_LAYER_IDS, the audit invariants, tileSource, and lists a stale category union
evidence: CONTRIBUTING.md:7-45 (recipe: add LayerDefinition to LAYER_REGISTRY, add to proxy LAYER_CONFIG, test) vs registry.ts:882-905 (LAYER_REGISTRY_AVAILABLE filters on PUBLIC_LAYER_IDS) and src/types/layers.ts:2-9 (LayerCategory = forest | accountability | disturbance | water | species | protection | context)

title: scripts/lib has zero unit tests: the audit suite's own math (tile-math, quality-score, geometry-precision, feature-matcher) is unguarded, and vitest cannot see it
evidence: vitest.config.ts:6 (include: src/**/*.test.ts only); `ls scripts/**/*.test.*` empty; scripts/lib/tile-math.ts (80 lines), quality-score.ts (376), geometry-precision.ts (275), feature-matcher.ts — all pure functions
detail: The charter's phase-1 gate is 'a green fidelity audit suite'; the suite's verdicts come from these modules (Hausdorff/area divergence in geometry-precision, the 0.50 fingerprint match threshold in feature-matcher, the composite score in quality-score) and nothing checks that they compute what the thresholds in audit-config assume. A wrong sign in area divergence or an off-by-one in tile-math's lat/lon→tile would make every audit pass or fail uniformly and nobody would know — the previous refresh found exactly that shape of hollowness in the src/test/audit suites (tautological asserts, fail-open opacity audit). This is real but it is a build-a-test-net task (M, needs fixtures with known answers, a vitest include for scripts/lib), not a cleanup, and the audits are cross-checked by running against a known archive; declining for this pass and naming it so it is indexed. If picked up: start with tile-math (pure, 80 lines, and shared by every audit and the story prefetch) and the feature-matcher threshold.
bucket_reason: worthwhile but a test-net build, not a refresh action; name it in the Parking Lot

summary: The slice outside src/ is in decent shape structurally — every package.json script target exists (no dolly remnants), no Python script imports anything the 08-05 sweep deleted, nothing large is tracked (top file 600 KB; the 186 story PNGs at 10.3 MB are all referenced), the reduced-motion scrollama guard is intact, METHODOLOGY matches calculator.ts to the constant, and the T0–T3 relay fixes (extractor-derived fixtures, taxonomy SSOT) landed cleanly. The single most important item is R4-01: CI on main has been red on all three runs since 2026-08-22 purely on the `npm audit --audit-level=high` step (nanoid 3.3.17 and browserslist 4.28.6, both dev-only), and `npm audit fix` resolves both within existing semver ranges with no major bump — one lockfile commit. Close behind: the only live monitor (audit:live) fails by construction because two tests assert layers PUBLIC_LAYER_IDS removed (R4-02), and the screenshot isolation suite is 12 copies of one screenshot with a stale MapLibre id (R4-03). The docs have drifted more than the tooling: README still sells 17 layers and an 'Ecology' preset, CONTRIBUTING's recipe yields an invisible layer, and ARCHITECTURE misses four src dirs, the global-state timeline, and the entire Python story-overlay path (R4-08/09/10). One audit-scope defect worth a relay: conservation-priority is excluded from precision/spatial audits on a premise I disproved by reading the live v10 archive header (R4-04). Verified clean: R2 URL SSOT in src (one shell-script exception, R4-07), proxy origin lock unaffected by the request-level e2e test, knip's coverage-v8 flag is a false positive, unlisted deps are transitive but should be declared (R4-14).
